apname.description: The name of the AirPort device as it appears in iOS/Mac discovery.

password.description: The password used for pairing with the AirPort device.

server_port.description: The network port for the RAOP service.

hwaddr.description: The MAC address of the network interface, used to identify the device or for multiple instances.

ao_driver.description: The audio output driver (e.g., alsa, pulse).

ao_devicename.description: The specific device name for the audio output driver. Leave empty for default.

ao_deviceid.description: The device ID for the audio output driver. Leave empty for default.
